local Players            = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace          = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage  = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CollectionService  = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local UserInputService   = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService         = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService       = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui   = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local WeaponControllerFolder = ReplicatedStorage
    :WaitForChild("CORE")
    :WaitForChild("Controllers")
    :WaitForChild("WeaponController")

local WeaponState = require(WeaponControllerFolder:WaitForChild("WeaponState"))
local FireSystem  = require(WeaponControllerFolder:WaitForChild("FireSystem"))
local AimAssist   = require(WeaponControllerFolder:WaitForChild("AimAssist"))

local Knit = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Knit)
local WeaponController = Knit.GetController("WeaponController")

local Packets = require(
    ReplicatedStorage
        :WaitForChild("CORE")
        :WaitForChild("Network")
        :WaitForChild("Packets")
)

local CONFIG = {
    Enabled          = true,
    FOV              = 300,
    AimCone          = 180,
    FullCircle       = true,
    TargetHead       = true,
    TargetPlayers    = true,
    TargetBots       = true,
    TargetTeam       = false,
    AliveCheck       = true,
    IgnoreForceField = false,
    OnScreenCheck    = true,
    VisibleCheck     = true,
    Keybind          = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,

    TriggerbotEnabled    = false,
    TriggerbotKeybind    = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
    TriggerbotRequireLMB = false,
    TriggerbotMinDelay   = 0.20,

    AutoReloadThreshold  = 1,
    AutoReloadCooldown   = 1.5,

    AutoRespawn          = true,
    AutoRespawnDelay     = 0,
    AutoRespawnKeybind   = Enum.KeyCode.Backspace,

    RestoreDeathPosition = true,
    RestoreDelay         = 0.15,

    ESPEnabled     = true,
    ESPFill        = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40),
    ESPOutline     = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    ESPText        = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    ESPTextStroke  = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
    ESPLabel       = "LUCKY BLOCK",
}

local SilentAimEnabled  = CONFIG.Enabled
local TriggerbotEnabled = CONFIG.TriggerbotEnabled

local function GetCamera()
    return Workspace.CurrentCamera
end

local function BuildUI()
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name            = "SilentAimUI"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn    = false
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset  = true
    gui.ZIndexBehavior  = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    gui.Parent          = PlayerGui

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(1, 0)
    frame.Position               = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 12)
    frame.Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 200)
    frame.BackgroundColor3       = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    frame.BorderSizePixel        = 0
    frame.Parent                 = gui

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    corner.Parent = frame

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color        = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)
    stroke.Thickness    = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.4
    stroke.Parent       = frame

    local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    padding.PaddingTop    = UDim.new(0, 8)
    padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
    padding.PaddingLeft   = UDim.new(0, 10)
    padding.PaddingRight  = UDim.new(0, 10)
    padding.Parent        = frame

    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.FillDirection       = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
    layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    layout.VerticalAlignment   = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
    layout.SortOrder           = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Padding             = UDim.new(0, 4)
    layout.Parent              = frame

    local aimStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    aimStatus.Name                   = "AimStatus"
    aimStatus.LayoutOrder            = 1
    aimStatus.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    aimStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    aimStatus.Font                   = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    aimStatus.TextSize               = 15
    aimStatus.TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    aimStatus.Text                   = "Silent Aim: ON"
    aimStatus.TextColor3             = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 100)
    aimStatus.Parent                 = frame

    local trigStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    trigStatus.Name                   = "TrigStatus"
    trigStatus.LayoutOrder            = 2
    trigStatus.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    trigStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    trigStatus.Font                   = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    trigStatus.TextSize               = 15
    trigStatus.TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    trigStatus.Text                   = "Triggerbot: OFF"
    trigStatus.TextColor3             = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
    trigStatus.Parent                 = frame

    local respawnStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    respawnStatus.Name                   = "RespawnStatus"
    respawnStatus.LayoutOrder            = 3
    respawnStatus.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    respawnStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    respawnStatus.Font                   = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    respawnStatus.TextSize               = 15
    respawnStatus.TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    respawnStatus.Text                   = "Auto-Respawn: ON"
    respawnStatus.TextColor3             = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 100)
    respawnStatus.Parent                 = frame

    local hintLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    hintLabel.Name                   = "Hint"
    hintLabel.LayoutOrder            = 4
    hintLabel.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
    hintLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hintLabel.Font                   = Enum.Font.Gotham
    hintLabel.TextSize               = 10
    hintLabel.TextWrapped            = true
    hintLabel.TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    hintLabel.TextColor3             = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    hintLabel.Text                   = "RightShift / RightControl / Backspace to toggle"
    hintLabel.Parent                 = frame

    local aimBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    aimBtn.Name             = "AimBtn"
    aimBtn.LayoutOrder      = 5
    aimBtn.Size             = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
    aimBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 60)
    aimBtn.BorderSizePixel  = 0
    aimBtn.AutoButtonColor  = true
    aimBtn.Font             = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    aimBtn.TextSize         = 13
    aimBtn.TextColor3       = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    aimBtn.Text             = "TOGGLE SILENT AIM"
    aimBtn.Parent           = frame

    local aimBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    aimBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    aimBtnCorner.Parent = aimBtn

    local trigBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    trigBtn.Name             = "TrigBtn"
    trigBtn.LayoutOrder      = 6
    trigBtn.Size             = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
    trigBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
    trigBtn.BorderSizePixel  = 0
    trigBtn.AutoButtonColor  = true
    trigBtn.Font             = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    trigBtn.TextSize         = 13
    trigBtn.TextColor3       = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    trigBtn.Text             = "TOGGLE TRIGGERBOT"
    trigBtn.Parent           = frame

    local trigBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    trigBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    trigBtnCorner.Parent = trigBtn

    return {
        gui = gui, frame = frame,
        aimStatus = aimStatus, trigStatus = trigStatus,
        respawnStatus = respawnStatus,
        hint = hintLabel, aimBtn = aimBtn, trigBtn = trigBtn,
    }
end

local UI = BuildUI()

local function RefreshUI()
    if SilentAimEnabled then
        UI.aimStatus.Text          = "Silent Aim: ON"
        UI.aimStatus.TextColor3    = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 100)
        UI.aimBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 60)
    else
        UI.aimStatus.Text          = "Silent Aim: OFF"
        UI.aimStatus.TextColor3    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
        UI.aimBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
    end

    if TriggerbotEnabled then
        UI.trigStatus.Text          = "Triggerbot: ON"
        UI.trigStatus.TextColor3    = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 100)
        UI.trigBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 60)
    else
        UI.trigStatus.Text          = "Triggerbot: OFF"
        UI.trigStatus.TextColor3    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
        UI.trigBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
    end

    if CONFIG.AutoRespawn then
        UI.respawnStatus.Text       = "Auto-Respawn: ON"
        UI.respawnStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 100)
    else
        UI.respawnStatus.Text       = "Auto-Respawn: OFF"
        UI.respawnStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
    end
end

local function SetSilentAim(state)
    SilentAimEnabled = state
    RefreshUI()
end

local function SetTriggerbot(state)
    TriggerbotEnabled = state
    RefreshUI()
end

local function ToggleAutoRespawn()
    CONFIG.AutoRespawn = not CONFIG.AutoRespawn
    RefreshUI()
end

UI.aimBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    SetSilentAim(not SilentAimEnabled)
end)

UI.trigBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    SetTriggerbot(not TriggerbotEnabled)
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe then return end
    if input.KeyCode == CONFIG.Keybind then
        SetSilentAim(not SilentAimEnabled)
    elseif input.KeyCode == CONFIG.TriggerbotKeybind then
        SetTriggerbot(not TriggerbotEnabled)
    elseif input.KeyCode == CONFIG.AutoRespawnKeybind then
        ToggleAutoRespawn()
    end
end)

RefreshUI()

local function GetTeam(inst)
    return inst:GetAttribute("RoundTeam")
end

local function IsEnemyPlayer(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return false end
    if CONFIG.TargetTeam then return true end

    local myTeam, theirTeam = GetTeam(LocalPlayer), GetTeam(player)
    if myTeam == nil or theirTeam == nil then return true end
    return myTeam ~= theirTeam
end

local function IsEnemyBot(bot)
    if CONFIG.TargetTeam then return true end
    local myTeam, theirTeam = GetTeam(LocalPlayer), GetTeam(bot)
    if myTeam == nil or theirTeam == nil then return true end
    return myTeam ~= theirTeam
end

local function HasLineOfSight(origin, targetPart, character)
    local cam = GetCamera()
    if not cam then return true end

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType  = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true

    local filter = { cam }
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        table.insert(filter, LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
    local we = Workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponEffects")
    if we then table.insert(filter, we) end

    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter

    local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, targetPart.Position - origin, params)
    if not hit then return true end
    return hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end

local function IsOnScreen(worldPos)
    local cam = GetCamera()
    if not cam then return false end
    local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
    if not onScreen then return false end
    if screenPos.Z <= 0 then return false end
    return true
end

local function ConsiderTarget(origin, lookUnit, character, targetPart, best)
    if not targetPart then return best end

    if CONFIG.AliveCheck then
        local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return best end
    end

    if not CONFIG.IgnoreForceField then
        if character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then return best end
    end

    local dir  = targetPart.Position - origin
    local dist = dir.Magnitude

    if dist <= 0.1 or dist > CONFIG.FOV then return best end

    local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(lookUnit:Dot(dir.Unit), -1, 1))

    if not CONFIG.FullCircle then
        if angle >= math.rad(CONFIG.AimCone) then return best end
        if CONFIG.OnScreenCheck and not IsOnScreen(targetPart.Position) then return best end
    end

    if CONFIG.VisibleCheck and not HasLineOfSight(origin, targetPart, character) then return best end

    local score
    if CONFIG.FullCircle then
        score = dist
    else
        score = angle * 10 + dist * 0.01
    end

    if not best or score < best.score then
        return { part = targetPart, score = score }
    end
    return best
end

local function GatherBots()
    local seen = {}
    local out  = {}

    local function add(m)
        if not m or seen[m] then return end
        if not m:IsA("Model") then return end
        if m:HasTag("RagdollRig") then return end
        if not m:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then return end
        seen[m] = true
        table.insert(out, m)
    end

    for _, v in CollectionService:GetTagged("Bot") do add(v) end
    for _, v in CollectionService:GetTagged("NPC") do add(v) end

    for _, v in Workspace:GetDescendants() do
        if v:IsA("Model") and v:GetAttribute("IsBot") == true then
            add(v)
        end
    end

    return out
end

local function GetBestTarget(origin, lookUnit)
    local best = nil

    if CONFIG.TargetPlayers then
        for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
            if IsEnemyPlayer(player) then
                local char = player.Character
                if char then
                    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    local hrp  = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local part = (CONFIG.TargetHead and head) or hrp
                    best = ConsiderTarget(origin, lookUnit, char, part, best)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if CONFIG.TargetBots then
        for _, bot in GatherBots() do
            if IsEnemyBot(bot) then
                local head  = bot:FindFirstChild("Head")
                local hrp   = bot:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local torso = bot:FindFirstChild("Torso") or bot:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                local part  = (CONFIG.TargetHead and head) or hrp or torso
                best = ConsiderTarget(origin, lookUnit, bot, part, best)
            end
        end
    end

    return best and best.part or nil
end

local originalApply = AimAssist.ApplyBulletMagnetism

AimAssist.ApplyBulletMagnetism = function(origin, direction, isAiming)
    if not SilentAimEnabled then
        return originalApply(origin, direction, isAiming)
    end

    local magnitude = direction.Magnitude
    if magnitude <= 0 then return direction end

    local target = GetBestTarget(origin, direction.Unit)
    if not target then
        return originalApply(origin, direction, isAiming)
    end

    local toTarget = target.Position - origin
    if toTarget.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
        return direction
    end

    return toTarget.Unit * magnitude
end

local originalFireRequestSend = Packets.Combat.FireRequest.send

Packets.Combat.FireRequest.send = function(payload)
    if SilentAimEnabled and payload and payload.Origin and payload.Direction then
        local magnitude = payload.Direction.Magnitude
        if magnitude > 0 then
            local target = GetBestTarget(payload.Origin, payload.Direction.Unit)
            if target then
                payload = {
                    ShotId    = payload.ShotId,
                    Origin    = payload.Origin,
                    Direction = (target.Position - payload.Origin).Unit * magnitude,
                    FireTime  = payload.FireTime,
                }
            end
        end
    end
    return originalFireRequestSend(payload)
end

local lastTriggerFire       = 0
local lastAutoReloadAttempt = 0

local function PrimeFire()
    local prev = WeaponState.MouseDown
    WeaponState.MouseDown = true
    local ok, err = pcall(FireSystem.PerformFire)
    WeaponState.MouseDown = prev or false
    if not ok then
        warn("[Triggerbot] PerformFire error:", err)
    end
end

local function TriggerbotStep()
    if not TriggerbotEnabled or not SilentAimEnabled then return end
    if not WeaponState.CurrentConfig then return end
    if os.clock() < WeaponState.FirstTimeEquipUntil then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

    if WeaponState.CurrentAmmo <= CONFIG.AutoReloadThreshold
        and not WeaponState.IsReloading then

        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastAutoReloadAttempt >= CONFIG.AutoReloadCooldown then
            lastAutoReloadAttempt = now
            if WeaponController and WeaponController.Reload then
                pcall(function()
                    WeaponController:Reload()
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    if WeaponState.IsReloading then return end
    if WeaponState.CurrentAmmo <= CONFIG.AutoReloadThreshold then return end

    if CONFIG.TriggerbotRequireLMB
        and not UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
        return
    end

    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastTriggerFire < CONFIG.TriggerbotMinDelay then return end

    local cam = GetCamera()
    if not cam then return end

    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local look   = cam.CFrame.LookVector

    local target = GetBestTarget(origin, look)
    if not target then return end

    lastTriggerFire = now
    PrimeFire()
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(TriggerbotStep)

local GameService = Knit.GetService("GameService")

local respawnBusy         = false
local savedDeathCFrame    = nil
local restoreToken        = 0

local function RespawnNow()
    if not CONFIG.AutoRespawn then return end
    if respawnBusy then return end
    respawnBusy = true

    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        GameService:RespawnInRound()
    end)

    if not ok then
        warn("[AutoRespawn] RespawnInRound error:", err)
    end

    task.delay(1, function()
        respawnBusy = false
    end)
end

local function RestoreDeathPosition(char)
    if not CONFIG.RestoreDeathPosition then return end
    if not savedDeathCFrame then return end

    restoreToken = restoreToken + 1
    local myToken = restoreToken
    local cframe = savedDeathCFrame
    savedDeathCFrame = nil

    task.spawn(function()
        local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        if not hrp then return end

        task.wait(CONFIG.RestoreDelay)

        if myToken ~= restoreToken then return end
        if LocalPlayer.Character ~= char then return end

        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

        hrp.CFrame = cframe

        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        if myToken ~= restoreToken then return end
        if LocalPlayer.Character ~= char then return end
        if not hrp.Parent then return end

        local snapped = (hrp.Position - cframe.Position).Magnitude > 5
        if snapped then
            hrp.CFrame = cframe
        end
    end)
end

local function HookCharacter(char)
    if not char then return end

    RestoreDeathPosition(char)

    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    if not hum then return end

    hum.Died:Connect(function()
        if CONFIG.RestoreDeathPosition then
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                savedDeathCFrame = hrp.CFrame
            end
        end

        if not CONFIG.AutoRespawn then return end

        if CONFIG.AutoRespawnDelay > 0 then
            task.delay(CONFIG.AutoRespawnDelay, RespawnNow)
        else
            task.defer(RespawnNow)
        end
    end)
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then
    HookCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(HookCharacter)

local function BuildLuckyBlockESP(model)
    if not model or not model:IsA("Model") then return end
    if model:FindFirstChild("LuckyBlockESP") then return end
    if not CONFIG.ESPEnabled then return end

    local root = model.PrimaryPart
        or model:FindFirstChild("Block")
        or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)

    if not root then return end

    local container = Instance.new("Folder")
    container.Name = "LuckyBlockESP"
    container.Parent = model

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name                = "LuckyBlockHighlight"
    highlight.Adornee             = model
    highlight.FillColor           = CONFIG.ESPFill
    highlight.OutlineColor        = CONFIG.ESPOutline
    highlight.FillTransparency    = 0.7
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.DepthMode           = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.Parent              = container

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name           = "LuckyBlockLabel"
    billboard.Adornee        = root
    billboard.Size           = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 30)
    billboard.StudsOffset    = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop    = true
    billboard.LightInfluence = 0
    billboard.MaxDistance    = 5000
    billboard.Parent         = container

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Size                   = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    label.Font                   = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextSize               = 16
    label.Text                   = CONFIG.ESPLabel
    label.TextColor3             = CONFIG.ESPText
    label.TextStrokeColor3       = CONFIG.ESPTextStroke
    label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    label.Parent                 = billboard
end

local function WatchLuckyBlock(inst)
    if not inst then return end
    task.defer(function()

        end

end

CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("LuckyBlock"):Connect(WatchLuckyBlock)

    while task.wait(0.5) do
        local cheese = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Cheese")
        if cheese then

local ALONE_TEXT       = "All players left"
local ALONE_HOLD       = 5
local ALONE_SLIDE_TIME = 0.5
local ALONE_ON_X       = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -12)
local ALONE_OFF_X      = UDim2.new(1, 260, 1, -12)

local AloneGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
AloneGui.Name           = "AloneNoticeUI"
AloneGui.ResetOnSpawn   = false
AloneGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
AloneGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
AloneGui.Parent         = PlayerGui

local AloneLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
AloneLabel.Name                   = "AloneNotice"
AloneLabel.AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(1, 1)
AloneLabel.Position               = ALONE_OFF_X
AloneLabel.Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 40)
AloneLabel.BackgroundColor3       = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
AloneLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
AloneLabel.BorderSizePixel        = 0
AloneLabel.Font                   = Enum.Font.GothamBold
AloneLabel.TextSize               = 16
AloneLabel.TextColor3             = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
AloneLabel.Text                   = ALONE_TEXT
AloneLabel.Visible                = true
AloneLabel.Parent                 = AloneGui

local AloneCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
AloneCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
AloneCorner.Parent = AloneLabel

local AloneStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
AloneStroke.Color        = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)
AloneStroke.Thickness    = 1
AloneStroke.Transparency = 0.4
AloneStroke.Parent       = AloneLabel

local aloneVisible   = false
local aloneHideToken = 0

local function SlideInAlone()
    if aloneVisible then return end
    aloneVisible = true
    aloneHideToken = aloneHideToken + 1

    TweenService:Create(
        AloneLabel,
        TweenInfo.new(ALONE_SLIDE_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        { Position = ALONE_ON_X }
    ):Play()

    local myToken = aloneHideToken
    task.delay(ALONE_HOLD, function()
        if myToken ~= aloneHideToken then return end
        if not aloneVisible then return end

        TweenService:Create(
            AloneLabel,
            TweenInfo.new(ALONE_SLIDE_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
            { Position = ALONE_OFF_X }
        ):Play()

        aloneVisible = false
    end)
end

local function IsLocalPlayerAlone()
    for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

local aloneDebounce = false

local function CheckAlone()
    if IsLocalPlayerAlone() then
        if not aloneDebounce then
            aloneDebounce = true
            SlideInAlone()
        end
    else
        aloneDebounce = false
    end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function()
    task.defer(CheckAlone)
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
    task.defer(CheckAlone)
end)

task.defer(CheckAlone)

local function New(class, props)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k,v in pairs(props) do if k ~= "Parent" then pcall(function() o[k] = v end) end end

end
local function Corner(p, r) return New("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 4), Parent = p}) end
local function Stroke(p, c, t) return New("UIStroke", {Color = c or THEME.Border, Thickness = t or 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = p}) end
local function Pad(p, l,t,r,b) return New("UIPadding", {PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,l or 8), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,t or 6), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,r or 8), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,b or 6), Parent = p}) end
local function Connect(sig, fn)

end
pcall(function()

    local Main = New("Frame", {Name = "Main", Size = UDim2.new(0, 620, 0, 450), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -310, 0.5, -225), BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Main, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, Parent = Gui})

    do
        local drag, startPos, startInput = false, nil, nil
        Connect(TopBar.InputBegan, function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag = true startPos = Main.Position startInput = i.Position
                Connect(i.Changed, function() if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then drag = false end end)
            end
        end)
        Connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(i)
            if drag and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local d = i.Position - startInput
                Main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)

    local Window = {} Window.Gui = Gui Window.Main = Main Window.GuiRoot = parentGui
    local tabs = {} local first = true
    local function animatePage(leftCol, rightCol)
        ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0,162,0,14)
        Tween(ContentArea, {Position = UDim2.new(0,162,0,6)}, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
        for _,col in pairs({leftCol, rightCol}) do
            for _,box in pairs(col:GetChildren()) do
                if box:IsA("Frame") then
                    box.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
                    Tween(box, {BackgroundTransparency = 0}, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)

        end
    end
    function Window:Tab(name)
        local btn = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,32), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,30), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = THEME.DarkText, Text = "  " .. name, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, AutoButtonColor = false, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = Side})

        Connect(btn.MouseEnter, function() if not leftLine.Visible then Tween(btn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,36)}, 0.12) end end)
        Connect(btn.MouseLeave, function() if not leftLine.Visible then Tween(btn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,30)}, 0.12) end end)
        local page = New("ScrollingFrame", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ScrollBarThickness = 2, ScrollBarImageColor3 = ACCENT, AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0), ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, Parent = ContentArea})
        New("UIListLayout", {FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0,8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = page})
        local leftCol = New("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.5,-4,0,0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = page})
        New("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0,8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = leftCol})
        local rightCol = New("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.5,-4,0,0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = page})
        New("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0,8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = rightCol})
        local function select(noAnim)
            for _,t in pairs(tabs) do
                t.page.Visible = false
                Tween(t.btn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,30), TextColor3 = THEME.DarkText}, 0.15)

        local Tab = {}

                    if listF then pcall(function() listF:Destroy() end) listF = nil end

                        listF = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0), Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,44), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,20,24), ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = f})

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1  
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then  
  
			dragging = true  
			dragStart = input.Position  
			startPos = frame.Position  
  
			input.Changed:Connect(function()  
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then  
					dragging = false  
				end  
			end)  
		end  
	end)  
  
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)  
		if dragging and (  
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement  
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch  
		) then  
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart  
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(  
				startPos.X.Scale,  
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,  
				startPos.Y.Scale,  
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y

		end  
	end)

scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Full Coin Farm, Auto Ski and Auto Quest + More
scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for a Roblox ski game uses FishyUI and opens with RightAlt, attaching to the game's own live client modules so it drives the same ski state and run flow the game steps every frame. Auto coin farm routes the body coin to coin while keeping the run alive, with two movement modes: teleport, which writes CFrame straight onto each coin (no collision sweep, so nothing to hit on the way), and glide, which steps under the game's broad-phase band so the swept grab segment picks up whatever lies between coins. It reopens runs when they drop, clicks the game's own continue prompt after a wreck to skip the twenty-second timeout, and cycles the run once the server's per-run payout cap is reached. Quest handling ranks all roughly forty rotation quests, holds the six the farm can actually finish (coin, score, airtime, maxair, survive), swaps out ones it can't drive, and asks for finished ones — while skipping kinds like trick, ring and wallride that need input the farm never makes, and distance quests the server won't credit for a teleport. Live panels show ski state, credited coins, picked up, coins per minute, run count, quests held, quests completed, and XP, alongside a log of key events. Anti-AFK keeps the client from idling out, and a settings tab documents the game's own numbers — grab radius, stuck watchdog, run cap, and quest slots — plus whether live tables were verified. Theme and config saving work through FishyUI's addons but degrade gracefully if either is missing.

SKI, SKI ALPHA

pcall(function()

	local set = setthreadidentity or set_thread_identity or setthreadcontext or set_identity

	if set then pcall(set, 8) pcall(set, 7) end

end)

local RGB = Color3.fromRGB

local CREDIT_LINK = "https://discord.gg/7Pfw9GWnub"
local CREDIT_TEXT = "Open sourced and removed key system by " .. CREDIT_LINK

local function copyLink()
	local ok = false
	pcall(function() if type(setclipboard) == "function" then setclipboard(CREDIT_LINK) ok = true end end)
	pcall(function()
		local s = game:GetService("StarterGui")
		if s and s.SetClipboard then s:SetClipboard(CREDIT_LINK) ok = true end
	end)
	return ok
end

local function creditWait()
	local player = game:GetService("Players")
	local tween = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local uis = game:GetService("UserInputService")

	local host
	pcall(function() if type(gethui) == "function" then host = gethui() end end)
	if type(host) ~= "Instance" then host = game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("RobloxGui") end
	if not host then host = player.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

	local done = false

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "LiquidHubCredit" gui.DisplayOrder = 999999 gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false gui.Parent = host

	local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
	bg.Name = "Backdrop" bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) bg.BackgroundColor3 = RGB(3, 5, 10)
	bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2 bg.BorderSizePixel = 0 bg.Active = true bg.Parent = gui

	local card = Instance.new("TextButton")
	card.Name = "Card" card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5) card.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, 240) card.BackgroundColor3 = RGB(10, 14, 22)
	card.BorderSizePixel = 0 card.AutoButtonColor = false card.Text = "" card.TextTransparency = 1
	card.Active = true card.Parent = bg

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner") corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) corner.Parent = card
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke") stroke.Color = RGB(28, 42, 62) stroke.Thickness = 1 stroke.Parent = card

	local function label(str, ypos, h, sz, col, align)
		local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		l.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, h) l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, ypos)
		l.BackgroundTransparency = 1 l.Font = Enum.Font.Code l.TextSize = sz
		l.Text = str l.TextColor3 = col l.TextXAlignment = align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		l.Active = false l.Parent = card
		return l
	end

	label("LIQUID HUB", 20, 14, 11, RGB(88, 102, 122))
	label("OPEN SOURCE", 20, 14, 11, RGB(18, 168, 255), Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)

	local rule = Instance.new("Frame")
	rule.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 1) rule.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 44)
	rule.BackgroundColor3 = RGB(28, 42, 62) rule.BorderSizePixel = 0 rule.Parent = card

	label("Key system removed", 60, 30, 24, RGB(226, 236, 246))
	local sub = label(CREDIT_TEXT, 96, 58, 13, RGB(122, 138, 160))
	sub.TextWrapped = true sub.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = "Copy" btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 40) btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 162)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = RGB(18, 168, 255) btn.BorderSizePixel = 0 btn.AutoButtonColor = false
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.Code btn.TextSize = 14 btn.Text = "copy link" btn.TextColor3 = RGB(4, 11, 24)
	btn.Active = true btn.Parent = card
	local bc = Instance.new("UICorner") bc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) bc.Parent = btn

	label("or press enter", 208, 14, 11, RGB(70, 82, 100), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)

	local function paint(target, col)
		tween:Create(target, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = col}):Play()
	end

	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() paint(btn, RGB(64, 198, 255)) end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() paint(btn, RGB(18, 168, 255)) end)
	card.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Color = RGB(54, 100, 146)}):Play() end)
	card.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Color = RGB(28, 42, 62)}):Play() end)

	local conn
	local function accept()
		if done then return end
		if not copyLink() then
			btn.Text = "copy failed - press enter to retry"
			paint(btn, RGB(196, 58, 78))
			return
		end
		done = true
		btn.Text = "copied - loading"
		if conn then conn:Disconnect() end

local function abbreviate(value)
	value = tonumber(value) or 0
	local units = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi" }
	local index = 1
	while value >= 1000 and index < #units do
		value /= 1000
		index += 1
	end
	if index == 1 then return tostring(math.floor(value)) end
	return string.format("%.2f%s", value, units[index])
end

local function formatClock(seconds)
	seconds = math.max(math.floor(seconds), 0)

	local minutes = math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
	local secs    = seconds % 60
	return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", hours, minutes, secs)
end

local function packSet(sel)
	if type(sel) ~= "table" then return "" end
	local names = {}
	for k, v in pairs(sel) do
		if type(k) == "string" then names[#names + 1] = k end
		if type(v) == "string" then names[#names + 1] = v end
	end
	table.sort(names)
	return table.concat(names, ",")
end

local function unpackSet(str)
	local set = {}
	if type(str) == "string" and str ~= "" then
		for name in string.gmatch(str, "[^,]+") do
			set[name] = true
		end
	end
	return set
end

local function asList(packed)
	local list = {}
	if type(packed) == "string" and packed ~= "" then
		for name in string.gmatch(packed, "[^,]+") do
			list[#list + 1] = name
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function selHas(sel, value)
	if type(sel) ~= "table" then return true end
	local count, hit = 0, false
	for k, v in pairs(sel) do
		count += 1
		if v == true and k == value then hit = true end
		if v == value then hit = true end
	end
	if count == 0 then return true end
	return hit
end

end

local function setNoclip(on)
	pcall(function()
		local char = getCharacter()
		if not char then return end
		for _, v in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.CanCollide = not on end
		end
		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then hrp.CanCollide = not on end
	end)
end

local function applyHideName(on)
	local char = getCharacter()
	if char then
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			hum.NameDisplayDistance = on and 0 or 100
			hum.DisplayName = on and "" or LocalPlayer.DisplayName
		end
		for _, gui in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if gui:IsA("BillboardGui") then
				gui.Enabled = not on
				for _, lbl in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
					if lbl:IsA("TextLabel") then
						lbl.Visible = not on
						lbl.TextTransparency = on and 1 or 0
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function noclipLoop()
	noclipRunning = true
	while getFlag("NoclipOn") and isCurrentGen() do
		pcall(function() setNoclip(true) end)
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	pcall(function() setNoclip(false) end)
	noclipRunning = false
end

local function applyWalkSpeed(v)
	currentWalkSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or defaultWalkSpeed, 8, 200)
	setFlag("WalkSpeed", currentWalkSpeed)
	local hum = getHumanoid()
	if hum then pcall(function() hum.WalkSpeed = currentWalkSpeed end) end
end

local function applyJump(v)
	currentJump = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or defaultJumpHeight, 0, 200)
	setFlag("JumpHeight", currentJump)
	local hum = getHumanoid()
	if hum then
		pcall(function()
			if hum.UseJumpPower then hum.JumpPower = currentJump else hum.JumpHeight = currentJump end
		end)
	end
end

local function stopFly()
	flyOn = false
	setFlag("FlyOn", false)
	if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect() flyConn = nil end
	if flyBV then flyBV:Destroy() flyBV = nil end
	if flyBG then flyBG:Destroy() flyBG = nil end
	local hum = getHumanoid()
	if hum then pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = false end) end
	pcall(function() setNoclip(getFlag("NoclipOn") == true) end)
end

local function startFly()
	local char = getCharacter()
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = getHumanoid()
	if not hrp or not hum then return end

	flyOn = true
	setFlag("FlyOn", true)
	pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = true end)

	flyBG = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	flyBG.P = 9e4
	flyBG.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
	flyBG.cframe = hrp.CFrame
	flyBG.Parent = hrp

	flyBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	flyBV.velocity = Vector3.zero
	flyBV.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
	flyBV.Parent = hrp

	setNoclip(true)

	flyConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not flyOn or not isCurrentGen() then stopFly() return end
		local char2 = getCharacter()
		local hrp2 = char2 and char2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not hrp2 or not flyBV or not flyBG or not cam then return end

		local move = Vector3.zero
		if flyKeys.W then move += cam.CFrame.LookVector end
		if flyKeys.S then move -= cam.CFrame.LookVector end
		if flyKeys.A then move -= cam.CFrame.RightVector end
		if flyKeys.D then move += cam.CFrame.RightVector end
		if flyKeys.Space then move += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
		if flyKeys.Ctrl then move -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
		if move.Magnitude > 0 then move = move.Unit * flySpeed end

		flyBV.velocity = move
		flyBG.cframe = cam.CFrame
	end)
end

	local k = input.KeyCode

	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.S then flyKeys.S = true

	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Space then flyKeys.Space = true
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or k == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then flyKeys.Ctrl = true end
end)

local function zoneReachable(zone)
	local required = ZoneJumpRequirements[zone]
	if required == nil then return true end
	local jp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("JumpPower")
	jp = jp and tonumber(jp.Value) or 0
	return jp >= required
end

local function findEggPrompt(mode)
	local map    = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local stages = map and map:FindFirstChild("Stages")
	if not stages then return nil, nil end

	local root = getRoot()
	local origin = root and root.Position or Vector3.zero
	local zoneFilter   = unpackSet(getFlag("StealZones"))
	local rarityFilter = unpackSet(getFlag("StealRarities"))

	local bestPrompt, bestScore, bestPosition

	for _, stage in ipairs(stages:GetChildren()) do
		local spawned = stage:FindFirstChild("SpawnedEggs")
		if spawned and selHas(zoneFilter, stage.Name) then
			for _, egg in ipairs(spawned:GetChildren()) do
				local rarity = egg:GetAttribute("Rarity")
				if selHas(rarityFilter, rarity) then
					local prompt = egg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
					if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
						local worldPosition = holderPosition(prompt.Parent)
						if worldPosition then
							local distance = (worldPosition - origin).Magnitude
							local rarityIndex = 0
							if Rarities and Rarities.GetIndex then
								rarityIndex = Rarities.GetIndex(rarity) or 0
							end
							local score
							if mode == "Nearest Egg" then
								score = -distance
							else

								if mode == "Best Egg" and not zoneReachable(stage.Name) then continue end
								score = rarityIndex * 1000000 - distance * 0.001
							end
							if not bestScore or score > bestScore then
								bestPrompt, bestScore, bestPosition = prompt, score, worldPosition
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return bestPrompt, bestPosition
end

local function doCarryRecovery()
	if not Toggles.AutoSteal.Value and not Toggles.AutoPlace.Value then
		CarryWatchSince = nil
		return
	end

	local carried = (tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("CarriedEggCount")) or 0) > 0
	local tool = findTool(isEggTool)

	if carried and not tool then
		local base = getPlacementDetector()
		local root = getRoot()
		if base and root and (root.Position - base.Position).Magnitude > 40 then
			teleportTo(base.Position)
			task.wait(0.4)
		end
		if not CarryWatchSince then
			CarryWatchSince = os.clock()
		elseif os.clock() - CarryWatchSince > 30 and DropEggRequest then
			DropEggRequest:FireServer()
			CarryWatchSince = os.clock()
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	else
		CarryWatchSince = nil
	end
end

local function doAutoTrain()
	if not Toggles.AutoTrain.Value then return end

	if Toggles.AutoHatch.Value and countReadyEggs() > 0 then
		if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsSquatting") == true and StopSquattingRequest then
			StopSquattingRequest:FireServer()
		end
		return
	end

	if Toggles.AutoSteal.Value and (tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("CarriedEggCount")) or 0) > 0 then
		return
	end

	local detector = getSquatDetector()
	local root = getRoot()
	if not detector or not root then return end

	if (root.Position - detector.Position).Magnitude > 10 then
		teleportTo(detector.Position)
		task.wait(0.3)
	end

	if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsSquatting") ~= true and SquatTrainingRequest then
		SquatTrainingRequest:FireServer(detector)
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
end

local function doAutoSquatBonus()
	if not Toggles.AutoSquatBonus.Value or not SquatBonusRequest then return end
	if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SquatBonusAvailable") ~= true then return end
	if os.clock() - LastBonusClaim < 0.4 then return end
	LastBonusClaim = os.clock()
	local version = math.floor(tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SquatBonusVersion")) or 0)
	SquatBonusRequest:FireServer(version)
end

local function doAutoPlace()
	if not Toggles.AutoPlace.Value or not PlaceEggRequest then return end
	if os.clock() < NextPlaceAttempt then return end

	local list = {}
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isEggTool(child) then table.insert(list, child) end
		end
	end)
	if #list == 0 then return end

	PlaceRotation += 1
	local carrying = list[(PlaceRotation % #list) + 1]
	local humanoid = getHumanoid()
	local detector = getPlacementDetector()
	if not humanoid or not detector then return end

	NextPlaceAttempt = os.clock() + 2
	pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(carrying) end)
	task.wait(0.2)

	PlaceEggRequest:FireServer(carrying:GetAttribute("EggId"), detector.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
	task.wait(0.35)

	if not carrying.Parent then
		local delay = tonumber(Options.StealDelay and Options.StealDelay.Value) or 5
		NextStealAt = os.clock() + math.max(delay, 0)
	end
end

local function doAutoSteal()
	if not Toggles.AutoSteal.Value then return end
	if os.clock() < NextStealAt then return end
	if countEggTools() >= 3 then return end
	if (tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("CarriedEggCount")) or 0) > 0 then return end

	local prompt, position = findEggPrompt(Options.StealMode and Options.StealMode.Value)
	if not prompt or not position then return end

	if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsSquatting") == true and StopSquattingRequest then
		StopSquattingRequest:FireServer()
		local deadline = os.clock() + 1.5
		while LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsSquatting") == true and os.clock() < deadline do
			task.wait(0.15)
		end
	end

	teleportTo(position)
	task.wait(0.35)
	if prompt.Enabled then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
	task.wait(0.4)

	local base = getPlacementDetector()
	if base then
		teleportTo(base.Position)
		task.wait(0.6)
	end
end

local function doAutoHatch()
	if not Toggles.AutoHatch.Value then return end
	local plot   = getPlot()
	local placed = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("PlacedEggs")
	if not placed then return end

	for _, egg in ipairs(placed:GetChildren()) do
		if egg:GetAttribute("HatchReady") == true then
			local prompt = egg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
			if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
				local position = holderPosition(prompt.Parent)
				if position then
					teleportTo(position)
					task.wait(0.25)
				end
				fireproximityprompt(prompt)
				task.wait(0.35)
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

local function findSellTarget()
	local mode   = Options.SellMode and Options.SellMode.Value
	local chosen = Options.AutoSellPet and Options.AutoSellPet.Value
	local maxCps = tonumber(Options.SellMaxCps and Options.SellMaxCps.Value) or 1000

	local bestTool, bestCps
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isPetTool(child) then
				local name = child:GetAttribute("AnimalName") or child.Name
				local cps  = tonumber(child:GetAttribute("CashPerSecond")) or math.huge
				if mode == "Chosen Pet" then
					if name == chosen and (not bestCps or cps < bestCps) then
						bestTool, bestCps = child, cps
					end
				elseif cps <= maxCps and (not bestCps or cps < bestCps) then
					bestTool, bestCps = child, cps
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	return bestTool
end

local function doAutoSell()
	if not Toggles.AutoSell.Value then return end
	if findTool(isEggTool) then return end

	local tool = findSellTarget()
	if not tool then return end

	local humanoid = getHumanoid()
	if not humanoid then return end
	pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(tool) end)

	local sellRoot = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") and workspace.Map:FindFirstChild("Sell")
	local detector = sellRoot and sellRoot:FindFirstChild("Detector", true)
	if detector and detector:IsA("BasePart") then
		teleportTo(detector.Position)
		task.wait(0.3)
	end

	local prompt = detector and detector:FindFirstChild("SellAnimalPrompt", true)
	if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
		fireproximityprompt(prompt)
	elseif SellRemote then
		SellRemote:FireServer()
	end
	task.wait(0.4)
end

local function doAutoOffline()
	if not Toggles.AutoOffline.Value or not OfflineRewardsRemote then return end
	if (tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("OfflineCashPending")) or 0) > 0 then
		OfflineRewardsRemote:FireServer("Claim")
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
end

local function doAutoIndex()
	if not Toggles.AutoIndex.Value or not IndexRewardRemote then return end
	if os.clock() - LastIndexClaim < 15 then return end
	LastIndexClaim = os.clock()
	IndexRewardRemote:FireServer("__ALL__")
end

local function ownedValue(folder, name)
	local entry = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	return entry and entry.Value == true
end

local function doAutoCoils()
	local coilData = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("CoilData")
	if not coilData or not CoilsRemote then return end

	local owned    = coilData:FindFirstChild("Owned")
	local equipped = coilData:FindFirstChild("Equipped")

	if Toggles.AutoBuyCoils.Value and SpeedUpgrades then
		for name in pairs(unpackSet(getFlag("BuyCoilList"))) do
			local config = SpeedUpgrades.Get(name)
			if config and not ownedValue(owned, name) and getCash() >= config.Cost then
				CoilsRemote:FireServer("Select", name)
				task.wait(0.25)
			end
		end
	end

	if Toggles.AutoEquipCoil.Value and SpeedUpgrades and equipped then
		local bestName, bestOrder = nil, -1
		if owned then
			for _, entry in ipairs(owned:GetChildren()) do
				if entry.Value == true then
					local config = SpeedUpgrades.Get(entry.Name)
					local order = config and config.Order or 0
					if order > bestOrder then
						bestName, bestOrder = entry.Name, order
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if bestName and equipped.Value ~= bestName then
			CoilsRemote:FireServer("Select", bestName)
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
	end
end

local function doAutoTrails()
	local trailData = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("TrailData")
	if not trailData or not TrailsRemote then return end

	local owned    = trailData:FindFirstChild("Owned")
	local equipped = trailData:FindFirstChild("Equipped")

	if Toggles.AutoBuyTrails.Value and TrailSettings then
		for name in pairs(unpackSet(getFlag("BuyTrailList"))) do
			local config = TrailSettings.Get(name)
			if config and not ownedValue(owned, name) and getCash() >= config.Cost then
				TrailsRemote:FireServer("Select", name)
				task.wait(0.25)
			end
		end
	end

	if Toggles.AutoEquipTrail.Value and TrailSettings and equipped then
		local bestName, bestOrder = nil, -1
		if owned then
			for _, entry in ipairs(owned:GetChildren()) do
				if entry.Value == true then
					local config = TrailSettings.Get(entry.Name)
					local order = config and config.Order or 0
					if order > bestOrder then
						bestName, bestOrder = entry.Name, order
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if bestName and equipped.Value ~= bestName then
			TrailsRemote:FireServer("Select", bestName)
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
	end
end

local function doAutoBarbell()
	if not Toggles.AutoBarbell.Value or not BarbellUpgrades or not BarbellUpgrades.GetNext then return end
	if os.clock() - LastBarbellAction < 3 then return end
	LastBarbellAction = os.clock()

	local level = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("BarbellLevel")
	if not level then return end

	local nextUpgrade = BarbellUpgrades.GetNext(math.max(math.floor(tonumber(level.Value) or 1), 1))
	if not nextUpgrade then return end
	if getCash() < (tonumber(nextUpgrade.CashPrice) or 0) then return end

	local plot     = getPlot()
	local zone     = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("SquatZone")
	local upgradeB = zone and zone:FindFirstChild("UpgradeB")
	local prompt   = upgradeB and upgradeB:FindFirstChild("BarbellUpgradePrompt", true)
	if not prompt or not prompt.Enabled then return end

	local position = holderPosition(prompt.Parent)
	if position then
		teleportTo(position)
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
	fireproximityprompt(prompt)
	task.wait(0.4)
end

local function findMutationPet(targetName)
	local candidate, candidateCps
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isPetTool(child) then
				local name = child:GetAttribute("AnimalName") or child.Name
				local cps  = tonumber(child:GetAttribute("CashPerSecond")) or math.huge
				if name == targetName and (not candidateCps or cps < candidateCps) then
					candidate, candidateCps = child, cps
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	return candidate
end

local function findDuplicateAnimal()
	local counts, lowest = {}, {}
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isPetTool(child) then
				local name = child:GetAttribute("AnimalName") or child.Name
				local cps  = tonumber(child:GetAttribute("CashPerSecond")) or math.huge
				counts[name] = (counts[name] or 0) + 1
				if not lowest[name] or cps < lowest[name] then lowest[name] = cps end
			end
		end
	end)

	local bestName, bestCps
	for name, count in pairs(counts) do
		if count >= 2 and (not bestCps or lowest[name] < bestCps) then
			bestName, bestCps = name, lowest[name]
		end
	end
	return bestName
end

local function mutationDetector()
	local map       = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local mutations = map and map:FindFirstChild("Mutations")
	return mutations and mutations:FindFirstChild("Detector") or nil
end

local function fireMutation(name, detector)
	local prompt = detector and detector:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	if not prompt or not prompt.Enabled then return false end

	local position = holderPosition(prompt.Parent)
	if position then
		teleportTo(position)
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	fireproximityprompt(prompt)
	task.wait(0.35)
	return true
end

local function doAutoMutation()
	local active    = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MutationCraftActive") == true
	local ready     = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MutationCraftReady") == true
	local canRemove = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MutationCanRemove") == true
	local detector  = mutationDetector()

	if Toggles.AutoClaimMutation.Value and active and ready then
		fireMutation("MutationPrompt", detector)
		return
	end

	if Toggles.AutoReturnMutation.Value and active and canRemove then
		fireMutation("MutationRemovePrompt", detector)
		return
	end

	if not Toggles.AutoAddMutation.Value or active then return end

	local target = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MutationCraftAnimalName")
	if type(target) ~= "string" or target == "" then
		if Options.MutationMode and Options.MutationMode.Value == "Chosen Animal" then
			target = Options.MutationAnimal and Options.MutationAnimal.Value
		else
			target = findDuplicateAnimal()
		end
	end
	if not target or target == "None" then return end

	local tool = findMutationPet(target)
	if not tool then return end

	local humanoid = getHumanoid()
	if not humanoid then return end

	pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(tool) end)
	task.wait(0.2)
	fireMutation("MutationPrompt", detector)
end

local function farmLoop(steps, interval)
	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentGen() do
			for _, step in ipairs(steps) do
				if not isCurrentGen() then return end
				local ok, err = pcall(step)
				if not ok and isCurrentGen() then
					warn("[Liquid Hub] " .. tostring(err))
				end
			end
			task.wait(interval or 0.5)
		end
	end)
end

farmLoop({
	doCarryRecovery,
	doAutoPlace,
	doAutoSteal,
	doAutoSell,
	doAutoTrain,
	doAutoSquatBonus,
	doAutoHatch,
	doAutoBarbell,
})

farmLoop({
	doAutoOffline,
	doAutoIndex,
	doAutoCoils,
	doAutoTrails,
})

farmLoop({ doAutoMutation }, 6)

task.spawn(function()
	while isCurrentGen() do
		task.wait(300)
		if isCurrentGen() and getFlag("AntiAfkOn") ~= false then
			pcall(function()
				local hum = getHumanoid()
				if hum then hum.Jump = true end
				local virtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
				virtualUser:CaptureController()
				virtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
			end)
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while isCurrentGen() do
		pcall(function()
			local uptime    = formatClock(os.clock() - StartedAt)
			local cash      = abbreviate(getCash())
			local level     = tostring(getLevel())
			local carried   = countEggTools()
			local placed    = countPlacedEggs()
			local squatting = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsSquatting") == true

			if StatusGrid and StatusGrid.SetValue then
				StatusGrid:SetValue("Cash", cash)
				StatusGrid:SetValue("Level", level)
				StatusGrid:SetValue("Eggs", string.format("%d / %d", carried, placed))
				StatusGrid:SetValue("Squat", squatting and "training" or "idle",
					squatting and BRAND.Cyan or BRAND.Sheen)
				StatusGrid:SetValue("Uptime", uptime)
			end

			if StatusSession then
				StatusSession.Text = "Uptime: " .. uptime
				StatusCash.Text = "Cash: " .. cash
				StatusLevel.Text = "Level: " .. level
				StatusEggs.Text = string.format("Carried eggs: %d | Placed: %d", carried, placed)
				StatusSquat.Text = "Squatting: " .. tostring(squatting)
			end
		end)
		task.wait(1)
	end
end)

if SaveManager then
	pcall(function()
		SaveManager:SetLibrary(Library)
		SaveManager:IgnoreThemeSettings()
		SaveManager:SetIgnoreIndexes({ "MenuKeybind" })
		SaveManager:SetFolder("LiquidHub/JumpForAnimals")

		local addGroupbox = Tabs.Settings.AddGroupbox
		Tabs.Settings.AddGroupbox = function(self, info)
			info = info or {}
			info.Side = "Left"
			return addGroupbox(self, info)
		end

		local okBuild, buildErr = pcall(function()
			SaveManager:BuildConfigSection(Tabs.Settings)
		end)

		Tabs.Settings.AddGroupbox = addGroupbox

		if not okBuild then warn("[Liquid Hub] config section failed: " .. tostring(buildErr)) end

		SaveManager:LoadAutoloadConfig()
	end)
end

do
	local Team = Tabs.Credits:AddLeftGroupbox("Team", ICON.ShieldOK, true, false)
	Team:AddLabel("Owner - sempai.real")
	Team:AddLabel("Game: " .. GAME_NAME)

	pcall(function() Team:AddDivider() end)

	local Community = Tabs.Credits:AddLeftGroupbox("Community", ICON.Heart, true, false)
	pcall(function()

		Community:AddDiscordBox("Invite", {
			Avatar   = LOGO_ICON,
			Title    = "Liquid Hub",
			Subtitle = BRAND.Invite,
			Status   = "online",
			Accent   = BRAND.Azure,
			Link     = BRAND.Discord,
			Buttons  = {
				{
					Text  = "Copy Invite",
					Icon  = "copy",
					Copy  = true,
					Style = "Primary",
				},
				{
					Text  = "Copy Short",
					Icon  = "link",
					Copy  = BRAND.Invite,
					Style = "Secondary",
				},
			},
		})
	end)
	Community:AddLabel("Report bugs or request a game in Discord.", true)
end

splashClose()

Library:Notify({
	Title = BRAND.Name,
	Description = "Loaded for " .. GAME_NAME .. ". RightShift toggles the menu.",
	Time = 5,
	Type = "Info",
})

end

local function getTheme()
    if currentTheme == "White" then

    local theme = {}

    for key, value in pairs(themes.Black) do

local function getAccent()
    if currentTheme == "Rainbow" then
        return Color3.fromHSV((tick() * 0.35) % 1, 0.8, 1)

    return getTheme().Accent

local function T(text)
    if language == "EN" then
        return text
    end

    local languageTable = translations[language]

    if languageTable then
        return languageTable[text] or text
    end

    return text
end

local function registerLanguageObject(object, englishText)
    table.insert(languageObjects, {
        Object = object,
        Text = englishText
    })

    object.Text = T(englishText)
end

local function round(object, radius)
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 9)
    corner.Parent = object
end

local function getCharacter()
    local character = player.Character

    if not character then
        return nil, nil, nil
    end

    return character,
        character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
        character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function setButtonState(button, state, onText, offText)
    button.Text = T(state and onText or offText)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = state and getAccent() or getTheme().Control
end

local function setInvisible(state)
    local character = player.Character

    if not character then
        return
    end

    invisible = state

    for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("BasePart") then
            if object.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                object.LocalTransparencyModifier = invisible and 1 or 0
            end
        elseif object:IsA("Decal") then
            object.Transparency = invisible and 1 or 0
        end
    end

    setButtonState(
        invisibleButton,
        invisible,
        "Invisible: ON",
        "Invisible: OFF"
    )
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- NOCLIP
--------------------------------------------------

local function enableNoclip()
    local character = player.Character

    if not character then
        return
    end

    for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("BasePart") then
            if originalCollisions[object] == nil then
                originalCollisions[object] = object.CanCollide
            end

            object.CanCollide = false
        end
    end
end

local function disableNoclip()
    for object, state in pairs(originalCollisions) do
        if object and object.Parent then
            object.CanCollide = state
        end
    end

    originalCollisions = {}
end

            0,
            1

    _G.__EriusAimbotRange.Value =
        math.floor(
            _G.__EriusAimbotRange.Min

local function getFOVCenter()
    if fovMode == "Crosshair" then
        local size = camera.ViewportSize
        return Vector2.new(size.X / 2, size.Y / 2)
    else
        local mouse = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
        local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()

        return Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y - inset.Y)
    end
end

local function validTarget(targetPlayer)
    if not targetPlayer
        or targetPlayer == player
        or not targetPlayer.Parent
        or not targetPlayer.Character then
        return false
    end

    local humanoid = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local head = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local targetRoot = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local _, myRoot = getCharacter()

    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not head then
        return false
    end

    if myRoot
        and targetRoot
        and _G.__EriusAimbotRange then

        local distance =
            (myRoot.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude

        if distance > _G.__EriusAimbotRange.Value then
            return false
        end
    end

    if ignoreNeutral and targetPlayer.Neutral then
        return false
    end

    if ignoreTeam
        and player.Team ~= nil
        and targetPlayer.Team ~= nil
        and targetPlayer.Team == player.Team then
        return false
    end

    if ignoreFriends then
        local ok, isFriend = pcall(function()
            return player:IsFriendsWith(targetPlayer.UserId)
        end)

        if ok and isFriend then
            return false
        end
    end

    return true
end

local function findClosestTarget()
    local center = getFOVCenter()
    local closest = nil
    local closestDistance = fovSize

    for _, targetPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if validTarget(targetPlayer) then
            local head = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")

            if head then
                local screenPos, onScreen =
                    camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)

                if onScreen then
                    local distance =
                        (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - center).Magnitude

                    if distance < closestDistance then
                        closestDistance = distance
                        closest = targetPlayer
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(input, gpe)
    if waitingForClickerKey and clickerOpen then
        if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
            clickerKey = input.KeyCode
            waitingForClickerKey = false
            refreshClickerVisual()
        end

        return
    end

    if clickerOpen
        and clickerKey
        and not gpe
        and not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()
        and input.KeyCode == clickerKey then

        if _G.__EriusClickerMode == "Hold" then
            _G.__EriusClickerKeyHeld = true
            clickerEnabled = true
        else
            clickerEnabled = not clickerEnabled
        end

        clickerAccumulator = 0
        refreshClickerVisual()
    end

    if gpe then
        return
    end

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
        rightMouseHeld = true

        if aimbotEnabled then
            currentTarget = findClosestTarget()
        end
    end
end)

local function updateRangeVisual()
    local percent = (espRange - minESPRange) / (maxESPRange - minESPRange)
    percent = math.clamp(percent, 0, 1)

    sliderFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(percent, 1)
    sliderKnob.Position = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 0.5, 0)
    rangeBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(espRange))
end

local slidingRange = false

local function setRangeFromMouse(x)
    local startX = sliderBackground.AbsolutePosition.X
    local width = sliderBackground.AbsoluteSize.X

    if width <= 0 then
        return
    end

    local percent = math.clamp((x - startX) / width, 0, 1)

    espRange = math.floor(
        minESPRange + percent * (maxESPRange - minESPRange)
    )

    updateRangeVisual()
end

connect(sliderBackground.InputBegan, function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        slidingRange = true
        setRangeFromMouse(input.Position.X)
    end
end)

connect(sliderKnob.InputBegan, function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        slidingRange = true
    end
end)

connect(rangeBox.FocusLost, function()
    local value = tonumber(rangeBox.Text)

    if value then
        espRange = math.clamp(value, minESPRange, maxESPRange)
    end

    updateRangeVisual()
end)

local function clearESP(model)
    local data = espObjects[model]

    if data then
        for _, object in pairs(data) do
            pcall(function()
                object:Destroy()
            end)
        end

        espObjects[model] = nil
    end
end

local function clearAllESP()
    local models = {}

    for model in pairs(espObjects) do
        table.insert(models, model)
    end

    for _, model in ipairs(models) do
        clearESP(model)
    end
end

local function createESP(model)
    if espObjects[model] then
        return
    end

    local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not head or not humanoid then
        return
    end

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.85
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.Adornee = model
    highlight.Parent = gui

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Adornee = head
    billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 45)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Parent = gui

    local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    text.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    text.TextSize = 13
    text.Parent = billboard

    espObjects[model] = {
        Highlight = highlight,
        Billboard = billboard,
        Text = text
    }
end

local function inESPRange(model)
    local _, myRoot = getCharacter()

    if not myRoot then
        return false
    end

    local targetRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not targetRoot then
        return false
    end

    return (myRoot.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude <= espRange
end

local function updatePlayerList()
    for _, child in ipairs(playerList:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local search = string.lower(teleportSearch or "")

    for _, targetPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if targetPlayer ~= player then
            local username = string.lower(targetPlayer.Name)
            local displayName = string.lower(targetPlayer.DisplayName)

            local matches =
                search == ""
                or string.find(username, search, 1, true)
                or string.find(displayName, search, 1, true)

            if matches then
                local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
                button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 35)
                button.BackgroundColor3 = getTheme().Control
                button.TextColor3 = getTheme().Text
                button.Text =
                    targetPlayer.DisplayName .. " (@" .. targetPlayer.Name .. ")"
                button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
                button.TextSize = 13
                button.Parent = playerList

                round(button, 7)

                connect(button.MouseButton1Click, function()
                    selectedTeleportPlayer = targetPlayer
                    refreshSelectedLabel()
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    task.wait()

    playerList.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(
        0,
        listLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 10
    )
end

    end

    if _G.__EriusFollow.Enabled then
        _G.__EriusFollow.Stop(false)
        return
    end

    if not selectedTeleportPlayer
        or selectedTeleportPlayer == player
        or not selectedTeleportPlayer.Parent
        or not selectedTeleportPlayer.Character then
        return
    end

    local targetRoot =
        selectedTeleportPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    local targetHumanoid =
        selectedTeleportPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not targetRoot
        or not targetHumanoid

        return
    end

    _G.__EriusFollow.Enabled = true

        _G.__EriusFollow.ModeIndex = 1
    end

    _G.__EriusFollow.Mode =
        _G.__EriusFollow.Modes[_G.__EriusFollow.ModeIndex]

    _G.__EriusFollow.Refresh()
end)

connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function()
    if not running
        or not _G.__EriusFollow
        or not _G.__EriusFollow.Enabled then
        return
    end

    if not selectedTeleportPlayer
        or selectedTeleportPlayer == player
        or not selectedTeleportPlayer.Parent then

        _G.__EriusFollow.Stop(true)
        return
    end

    local _, root, humanoid = getCharacter()
    local targetCharacter = selectedTeleportPlayer.Character

    if not root or not humanoid or not targetCharacter then
        return
    end

    local targetRoot =
        targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    local targetHumanoid =
        targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not targetRoot
        or not targetHumanoid
        or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then

        _G.__EriusFollow.Stop(false)
        return
    end

    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero

    if _G.__EriusFollow.Mode == "Float Behind" then
        humanoid.Sit = false
        humanoid.AutoRotate = false
        root.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.35, 4.5)

    elseif _G.__EriusFollow.Mode == "Shoulder" then
        humanoid.Sit = true
        humanoid.AutoRotate = false
        root.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(1.6, 2.8, 0)

    elseif _G.__EriusFollow.Mode == "Head Sit" then
        humanoid.Sit = true
        humanoid.AutoRotate = false
        root.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 4.2, 0)

    elseif _G.__EriusFollow.Mode == "Doggy" then
        humanoid.Sit = false
        humanoid.AutoRotate = false
        root.CFrame =
            targetRoot.CFrame
            * CFrame.new(0, -1.4, 3.2)
            * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(72), 0, 0)
    end
end)

_G.__EriusPlaceClickerBesideHub = function()
    local cameraNow = workspace.CurrentCamera

    if not cameraNow then
        return
    end

    local viewport = cameraNow.ViewportSize
    local gap = 14

    local hubX = main.AbsolutePosition.X
    local hubY = main.AbsolutePosition.Y
    local hubW = main.AbsoluteSize.X

    local clickerW =
        clickerMinimized
        and 150
        or 320

    local clickerH =
        clickerMinimized
        and 75
        or 375

    local rightX = hubX + hubW + gap
    local leftX = hubX - clickerW - gap

    local targetX

    if rightX + clickerW <= viewport.X - 8 then
        targetX = rightX
    elseif leftX >= 8 then
        targetX = leftX
    else
        if (viewport.X - (hubX + hubW)) >= hubX then
            targetX =
                math.clamp(
                    rightX,
                    8,
                    math.max(8, viewport.X - clickerW - 8)
                )
        else
            targetX =
                math.clamp(
                    leftX,
                    8,
                    math.max(8, viewport.X - clickerW - 8)
                )
        end
    end

    local targetY =
        math.clamp(
            hubY,
            8,
            math.max(8, viewport.Y - clickerH - 8)
        )

    clickerFrame.Position =
        UDim2.fromOffset(
            targetX,
            targetY
        )
end

local function performClickerClick()
    local didClick = false

    pcall(function()
        if type(mouse1click) == "function" then
            mouse1click()
            didClick = true
        elseif type(mouse1press) == "function"
            and type(mouse1release) == "function" then

            mouse1press()
            mouse1release()
            didClick = true
        end
    end)

    if didClick then
        return
    end

    pcall(function()
        local virtualInput = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
        local pos = UIS:GetMouseLocation()

        virtualInput:SendMouseButtonEvent(
            pos.X,
            pos.Y,
            0,
            true,
            game,
            0
        )

        virtualInput:SendMouseButtonEvent(
            pos.X,
            pos.Y,
            0,
            false,
            game,
            0
        )
    end)
end

    if not clickerDragging
        or not clickerDragStart
        or not clickerStartPosition then

        return

    local delta =
        input.Position
        -
        clickerDragStart

    if math.abs(delta.X) > 5
        or math.abs(delta.Y) > 5 then

        clickerMoved = true
    end

    clickerFrame.Position =
        UDim2.new(
            clickerStartPosition.X.Scale,
            clickerStartPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            clickerStartPosition.Y.Scale,
            clickerStartPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y

_G.__EriusPlaceSteelBesideHub = function()
    local cameraNow = workspace.CurrentCamera

    if not cameraNow then
        return
    end

    local viewport = cameraNow.ViewportSize
    local gap = 14
    local hubX = main.AbsolutePosition.X
    local hubY = main.AbsolutePosition.Y
    local hubW = main.AbsoluteSize.X

    local steelW =
        _G.__EriusSteelMinimized
        and 150
        or 320

    local steelH =
        _G.__EriusSteelMinimized
        and 75
        or 250

    local rightX = hubX + hubW + gap
    local leftX = hubX - steelW - gap
    local targetX

    if rightX + steelW <= viewport.X - 8 then
        targetX = rightX
    elseif leftX >= 8 then
        targetX = leftX
    else
        targetX =
            math.clamp(
                rightX,
                8,
                math.max(8, viewport.X - steelW - 8)
            )
    end

    local targetY =
        math.clamp(
            hubY + 160,
            8,
            math.max(8, viewport.Y - steelH - 8)
        )

    _G.__EriusSteelFrame.Position =
        UDim2.fromOffset(targetX, targetY)
end

local function applyTheme()

    end

    if _G.__EriusHubBackgroundShade
        and _G.__EriusHubBackgroundShade.Parent then

        _G.__EriusHubBackgroundShade.BackgroundColor3 =
            Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)

        _G.__EriusHubBackgroundShade.BackgroundTransparency =
            currentTheme == "White"
            and 0.60
            or 0.52
    end

    main.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Main
    main.BackgroundTransparency =
        currentTheme == "Erius"
        and 1

    if _G.__EriusHubBackground and _G.__EriusHubBackground.Parent then

            currentTheme == "Erius"

local function setCustomColorFromX(x)
    local startX = colorSlider.AbsolutePosition.X
    local width = colorSlider.AbsoluteSize.X

    if width <= 0 then
        return
    end

    local percent =
        math.clamp(
            (x - startX) / width,
            0,
            1
        )

    customColor =
        Color3.fromHSV(
            percent,
            0.8,
            1
        )

    colorKnob.Position =
        UDim2.new(
            percent,
            0,
            0.5,
            0
        )

    currentTheme = "Custom"
    applyTheme()
end

connect(colorSlider.InputBegan, function(input)
    if input.UserInputType
        == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType
        == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        colorSliding = true
        setCustomColorFromX(input.Position.X)
    end
end)

connect(colorKnob.InputBegan, function(input)
    if input.UserInputType

        == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

end)

        startupScale,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.22,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
            Enum.EasingDirection.Out
        ),

    ):Play()

    TweenService:Create(
        startupDescription,
        TweenInfo.new(0.18),
        {TextTransparency = 0}
    ):Play()

    local loadingTime = 1.25
    local startTime = tick()

    while running do
        local progress =
            math.clamp(
                (tick() - startTime) / loadingTime,
                0,
                1
            )

        local percent =
            math.floor(
                progress * 100
            )

        startupPercent.Text =
            tostring(percent)
            .. "%"

        startupBar.Size =
            UDim2.fromScale(
                progress,
                1
            )

        if progress >= 1 then
            break
        end

        RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
    end

    startupPercent.Text = "100%"
    startupBar.Size =
        UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

    task.wait(0.55)

    TweenService:Create(
        startupFrame,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.2,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,
            Enum.EasingDirection.In
        ),
        {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1
        }
    ):Play()

    TweenService:Create(
        startupScale,

        ),
