            Scale = 1.04
        }
    ):Play()

    for _, object in ipairs(
        startupFrame:GetDescendants()
    ) do
        if object:IsA("TextLabel") then
            TweenService:Create(
                object,
                TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                {
                    TextTransparency = 1
                }
            ):Play()

        elseif object:IsA("ImageLabel") then
            TweenService:Create(
                object,
                TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                {
                    ImageTransparency = 1
                }
            ):Play()

        elseif object:IsA("Frame")
            and object ~= startupFrame then

            TweenService:Create(
                object,
                TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1
                }
            ):Play()
        end
    end

    task.wait(0.22)

    if startupFrame
        and startupFrame.Parent then

    end

                Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
                Enum.EasingDirection.Out
            ),
            {
                Scale = hubScale
            }
        ):Play()
    else
        mainScale.Scale = hubScale
    end
end)

            end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(
                Enum.KeyCode.S
            ) then
                direction -=
                    camera.CFrame.LookVector
            end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(
                Enum.KeyCode.A
            ) then
                direction -=
                    camera.CFrame.RightVector
            end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(
                Enum.KeyCode.D
            ) then
                direction +=
                    camera.CFrame.RightVector
            end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(
                Enum.KeyCode.Space
            ) then
                direction +=
                    Vector3.new(
                        0,
                        1,
                        0
                    )
            end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(
                Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift
            ) then
                direction -=
                    Vector3.new(
                        0,
                        1,
                        0
                    )
            end

            if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
                direction =
                    direction.Unit

                _G.__EriusFlyHoldCFrame =
                    root.CFrame

                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
                    direction
                    *
                    flySpeed
            else
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
                    Vector3.zero

                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
                    Vector3.zero

                if not _G.__EriusFlyHoldCFrame then
                    _G.__EriusFlyHoldCFrame =
                        root.CFrame
                end

                root.CFrame =
                    _G.__EriusFlyHoldCFrame
            end

            humanoid:ChangeState(
                Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
            )
        end
    end

    --------------------------------------------------
    -- AIMBOT
    --------------------------------------------------

    local function hasClearShot(targetPlayer)
        if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then
            return false
        end

        local targetHead = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local myCharacter = player.Character

        if not targetHead or not myCharacter then
            return false
        end

        local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
        local direction = targetHead.Position - origin

        if direction.Magnitude <= 0 then
            return false
        end

        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {myCharacter}
        params.IgnoreWater = true

        local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)

        if not result then
            return true
        end

        return result.Instance
            and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetPlayer.Character)
    end

    local function triggerShoot()
        pcall(function()
            if type(mouse1click) == "function" then
                mouse1click()
                return
            end

            if type(mouse1press) == "function"
                and type(mouse1release) == "function" then

                mouse1press()
                task.wait(0.02)
                mouse1release()
                return
            end

            local virtualInput = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
            local pos = UIS:GetMouseLocation()

            virtualInput:SendMouseButtonEvent(
                pos.X,
                pos.Y,
                0,
                true,
                game,
                0
            )

            task.wait(0.02)

            virtualInput:SendMouseButtonEvent(
                pos.X,
                pos.Y,
                0,
                false,
                game,
                0
            )
        end)
    end

    if aimbotEnabled
        and rightMouseHeld then

        if currentTarget
            and validTarget(currentTarget) then

            local head =
                currentTarget.Character:
                FindFirstChild("Head")

            if head then
                camera.CFrame =
                    CFrame.new(
                        camera.CFrame.Position,
                        head.Position
                    )

                _G.__EriusAimLastLook =
                    camera.CFrame.LookVector

                local _, myRoot, myHumanoid =
                    getCharacter()

                if myRoot and myHumanoid then
                    if _G.__EriusAimWasAutoRotate == nil then
                        _G.__EriusAimWasAutoRotate =
                            myHumanoid.AutoRotate
                    end

                    myHumanoid.AutoRotate = false

                    -- Lock the character's yaw to the same direction
                    -- the aimbot/camera is currently aiming.
                    local cameraLook =
                        camera.CFrame.LookVector

                    local flatLook =
                        Vector3.new(
                            cameraLook.X,
                            0,
                            cameraLook.Z
                        )

                    if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                        myRoot.CFrame =
                            CFrame.lookAt(
                                myRoot.Position,
                                myRoot.Position
                                    + flatLook.Unit
                            )

                        _G.__EriusAimLastLook =
                            cameraLook
                    end
                end
            end

        elseif targetSwitching then
            currentTarget =
                findClosestTarget()
        end
    end

    if triggerAimEnabled
        and aimbotEnabled
        and rightMouseHeld
        and currentTarget
        and validTarget(currentTarget) then

        if hasClearShot(currentTarget) then
            if triggerAimReadyAt == 0 then
                triggerAimReadyAt = tick() + triggerAimDelay
            elseif tick() >= triggerAimReadyAt then
                triggerShoot()
                triggerAimReadyAt = tick() + triggerAimDelay
            end
        else
            triggerAimReadyAt = 0
        end
    else
        triggerAimReadyAt = 0
    end

    --------------------------------------------------
    -- PLAYER ESP
    --------------------------------------------------

    for _, targetPlayer in ipairs(
        Players:GetPlayers()
    ) do
        if targetPlayer ~= player
            and targetPlayer.Character then

            local char =
                targetPlayer.Character

            local humanoid =
                char:
                FindFirstChildOfClass(
                    "Humanoid"
                )

            local sameTeam =
                player.Team ~= nil
                and targetPlayer.Team ~= nil
                and targetPlayer.Team
                    == player.Team

            local allowed =
                espSettings.PlayerESP
                and inESPRange(char)
                and (
                    not sameTeam
                    or espSettings.TeamESP
                )

            if allowed
                and humanoid then

                createESP(char)

                local data =
                    espObjects[char]

                if data then
                    data.Highlight.Enabled =
                        espSettings.Box

                    local lines = {}

                    if espSettings.Nicknames then
                        table.insert(
                            lines,
                            targetPlayer.DisplayName
                        )
                    end

                    if espSettings.HP then
                        table.insert(
                            lines,
                            "HP: "
                            .. math.floor(
                                humanoid.Health
                            )
                            .. "/"
                            .. math.floor(
                                humanoid.MaxHealth
                            )
                        )
                    end

                    data.Text.Text =
                        table.concat(
                            lines,
                            "\n"
                        )

                    data.Billboard.Enabled =
                        espSettings.Nicknames
                        or espSettings.HP
                end
            else
                clearESP(char)
            end
        end
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------

connect(
    RunService.Heartbeat,
    function(dt)
        if not running then
            return
        end

        if clickerOpen
            and clickerEnabled then

            clickerAccumulator =
                clickerAccumulator
                +
                dt

            local interval =
                1
                /
                math.max(
                    clickerCPS,
                    1
                )

            local clicksThisFrame =
                0

            while clickerAccumulator
                >= interval
                and clicksThisFrame < 50 do

                clickerAccumulator =
                    clickerAccumulator
                    -
                    interval

                performClickerClick()

                clicksThisFrame =
                    clicksThisFrame
                    +
                    1
            end
        else
            clickerAccumulator =
                0
        end
    end
)

local npcTimer = 0

connect(
    RunService.Heartbeat,
    function(dt)
        if not running then
            return
        end

        npcTimer += dt

        if npcTimer < 1 then
            return
        end

        npcTimer = 0

        if not espSettings.NPCESP then
            for model in pairs(
                espObjects
            ) do
                if model
                    and model.Parent
                    and not Players:
                    GetPlayerFromCharacter(
                        model
                    ) then

                    clearESP(model)
                end
            end

            return
        end

        for _, model in ipairs(
            workspace:GetDescendants()
        ) do
            if model:IsA("Model") then
                local humanoid =
                    model:
                    FindFirstChildOfClass(
                        "Humanoid"
                    )

                local root =
                    model:
                    FindFirstChild(
                        "HumanoidRootPart"
                    )

                if humanoid
                    and root
                    and not Players:
                    GetPlayerFromCharacter(
                        model
                    ) then

                    if inESPRange(model) then
                        createESP(model)

                        local data =
                            espObjects[model]

                        if data then
                            data.Highlight.Enabled =
                                espSettings.Box

                            local lines = {}

                            if espSettings.Nicknames then
                                table.insert(
                                    lines,
                                    model.Name
                                )
                            end

                            if espSettings.HP then
                                table.insert(
                                    lines,
                                    "HP: "
                                    .. math.floor(
                                        humanoid.Health
                                    )
                                    .. "/"
                                    .. math.floor(
                                        humanoid.MaxHealth
                                    )
                                )
                            end

                            data.Text.Text =
                                table.concat(
                                    lines,
                                    "\n"
                                )

                            data.Billboard.Enabled =
                                espSettings.Nicknames
                                or espSettings.HP
                        end
                    else
                        clearESP(model)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

connect(
    UIS.InputEnded,
    function(input)
        if clickerOpen
            and clickerKey
            and _G.__EriusClickerMode == "Hold"
            and input.KeyCode == clickerKey then

            _G.__EriusClickerKeyHeld = false
            clickerEnabled = false
            clickerAccumulator = 0
            refreshClickerVisual()
        end

        if input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then

            rightMouseHeld = false

            local _, myRoot, myHumanoid =
                getCharacter()

            if _G.__EriusAimLastLook then
                local releaseLook =
                    _G.__EriusAimLastLook

                if myRoot then
                    local characterLook =
                        myRoot.CFrame.LookVector

                    local horizontal =
                        Vector3.new(
                            characterLook.X,
                            0,
                            characterLook.Z
                        )

                    if horizontal.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                        local vertical =
                            math.clamp(
                                releaseLook.Y,
                                -0.98,
                                0.98
                            )

                        local horizontalScale =
                            math.sqrt(
                                math.max(
                                    0.001,
                                    1 - vertical * vertical
                                )
                            )

                        releaseLook =
                            Vector3.new(
                                horizontal.Unit.X * horizontalScale,
                                vertical,
                                horizontal.Unit.Z * horizontalScale
                            ).Unit
                    end
                end

                camera.CFrame =
                    CFrame.lookAt(
                        camera.CFrame.Position,
                        camera.CFrame.Position
                            + releaseLook
                    )

                _G.__EriusAimLastLook =
                    releaseLook
            end

            if myHumanoid then
                if _G.__EriusAimWasAutoRotate ~= nil then
                    myHumanoid.AutoRotate =
                        _G.__EriusAimWasAutoRotate
                else
                    myHumanoid.AutoRotate = true
                end
            end

            _G.__EriusAimWasAutoRotate = nil
            currentTarget = nil
        end

        if input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            slidingRange = false

            if _G.__EriusAimbotRange then
                _G.__EriusAimbotRange.Sliding = false
            end

            colorSliding = false

            if clickerDragging then
                local source =
                    clickerDragSource

                local wasMoved =
                    clickerMoved

                clickerDragging = false
                clickerDragSource = nil
                clickerDragStart = nil
                clickerStartPosition = nil

                if source == "minimize"
                    and not wasMoved then

                    setClickerMinimized(
                        not clickerMinimized
                    )
                end
            end
        end
    end
)

connect(
    UIS.InputChanged,
    function(input)
        if slidingRange then
            if input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

                setRangeFromMouse(
                    input.Position.X

        if _G.__EriusAimbotRange

            if input.UserInputType

                or input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

                _G.__EriusAimbotRange.SetFromX(
                    input.Position.X

            end

        if colorSliding then
            if input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

                setCustomColorFromX(
                    input.Position.X
                )
            end
        end

        if clickerDragging then
            if input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

                updateClickerDrag(input)
            end

local function cleanup()
    if not running then
        return
    end

    running = false
    flying = false
    noclip = false
    aimbotEnabled = false
    _G.__EriusInfiniteJump = false
    _G.__EriusInstantInteract = false

    if _G.__EriusRestoreInstantPrompts then
        _G.__EriusRestoreInstantPrompts()
    end

    triggerAimEnabled = false
    triggerAimReadyAt = 0

    clickerEnabled = false
    clickerOpen = false
    _G.__EriusClickerKeyHeld = false
    clickerKey = nil
    waitingForClickerKey = false
    clickerAccumulator = 0

    rightMouseHeld = false
    currentTarget = nil

    local _, root, humanoid =
        getCharacter()

    if root then
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
            Vector3.zero
    end

    if humanoid then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed =
            normalSpeed
    end

    disableNoclip()

    if invisible then
        invisible = false

        local character =
            player.Character

        if character then
            for _, object in ipairs(
                character:GetDescendants()
            ) do
                if object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    object.LocalTransparencyModifier =
                        0
                elseif object:IsA("Decal") then
                    object.Transparency =
                        0
                end
            end
        end
    end

    clearAllESP()

    if blur then
        blur:Destroy()
    end

    if fovCircle then
        fovCircle:Destroy()
    end

    for _, connection in ipairs(
        connections
    ) do
        pcall(function()
            connection:Disconnect()
        end)
    end

    table.clear(connections)

    if gui then
        gui:Destroy()
    end
end

connect(
    leaveButton.MouseButton1Click,
    cleanup
)

--------------------------------------------------
-- DRAG
--------------------------------------------------

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition
local moved = false
local dragSource

local function startDrag(input, source)
    _G.__EriusBringWindowToFront("Hub")

    dragging = true
    moved = false
    dragSource = source
    dragStart = input.Position
    startPosition = main.Position
end

local function updateDrag(input)
    if not dragging then
        return
    end

    local delta =
        input.Position
        -
        dragStart

    if math.abs(delta.X) > 5
        or math.abs(delta.Y) > 5 then

        moved = true
    end

    main.Position =
        UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
end

                input,
                "minimize"
            )
        end
    end

                local steelMoved =
                    _G.__EriusSteelMoved

                _G.__EriusSteelDragging = false
                _G.__EriusSteelDragSource = nil
                _G.__EriusSteelDragStart = nil
                _G.__EriusSteelStartPosition = nil

                if steelSource == "minimize"
                    and not steelMoved
                    and _G.__EriusSetSteelMinimized then

                    _G.__EriusSetSteelMinimized(
                        not _G.__EriusSteelMinimized
                    )

            end

            if dragging then
                local source =
                    dragSource

                local wasMoved =
                    moved

                dragging = false
                dragSource = nil
                dragStart = nil
                startPosition = nil

                if source
                    == "minimize"
                    and not wasMoved then

                    setMinimized(
                        not minimized
                    )
                end
            end
        end
    end
)
